mapper.select: WITH target_tx AS ( -- 1. 기존 청약 신청 내역 조회 SELECT wallet_id, amount, trade_id FROM transaction_hists WHERE transaction_id = #{transactionId} AND transaction_type = 'SUBSCRIPTION'::transaction_type_enum -- 해당 내역이 청약 건인지 추가 검증 ), update_wallet AS ( -- 2. 지갑 잔액 환불 UPDATE wallets w SET cash_balance = w.cash_balance + t.amount FROM target_tx t WHERE w.wallet_id = t.wallet_id RETURNING w.wallet_id, w.cash_balance, t.amount, t.trade_id ) -- 3. 취소 내역 삽입 INSERT INTO transaction_hists ( transaction_id, trade_id, order_id, wallet_id, transaction_type, asset_type, direction, amount, balance_after, remaining_price, remaining_volume, created_at, fee, hash_value ) SELECT #{newTransactionId}, uw.trade_id, NULL, uw.wallet_id, 'FAIL', 'CASH', 'IN', uw.amount, uw.cash_balance, 0, 0, NOW(), 0, #{hashValue} FROM update_wallet uw RETURNING transaction_id, wallet_id, amount

insert.foreach:
-- 1. 청약 신청 정보 및 금액 계산 WITH result AS ( SELECT wallet_id, trade_id, amount as total_amount, #{item.passVolume} as pass_volume, (#{item.passPrice} * #{item.passVolume}) as pass_amount, (amount - (#{item.passPrice} * #{item.passVolume})) as fail_amount FROM transaction_hists WHERE trade_id = #{item.subscriptionId} AND wallet_id = #{item.walletId} AND transaction_type = 'SUBSCRIPTION'::transaction_type_enum LIMIT 1 ), -- 2. 지갑 잔액 환불, FAIL 금액 발생 시만 update_wallet AS ( UPDATE wallets w SET cash_balance = w.cash_balance + r.fail_amount, updated_at = NOW() FROM result r WHERE w.wallet_id = r.wallet_id AND r.fail_amount > 0 RETURNING w.wallet_id, w.cash_balance ), -- 3. 토큰 보유 기록 추가, PASS 수량 발생 시만 insert_holdings AS ( INSERT INTO holdings ( wallet_id, token_id, token_balance, reserved, purchased_value, created_at ) SELECT r.wallet_id, #{item.tokenId}, r.pass_volume, 0, r.pass_amount, NOW() FROM result r WHERE r.pass_volume > 0 RETURNING wallet_id, token_balance ) -- 4. 최종 거래 내역 기록 INSERT INTO transaction_hists ( transaction_id, trade_id, wallet_id, transaction_type, asset_type, direction, amount, balance_after, remaining_price, remaining_volume, created_at, fee, hash_value ) -- 4.1 당첨 내역, PASS SELECT #{item.passTxId}, r.trade_id, r.wallet_id, 'PASS'::transaction_type_enum, 'TOKEN'::asset_type_enum, 'IN'::direction_enum, r.pass_volume, ih.token_balance, 0, 0, NOW(), 0, #{item.passHashValue} FROM result r INNER JOIN insert_holdings ih ON r.wallet_id = ih.wallet_id WHERE r.pass_volume > 0
UNION ALL
-- 4.2 환불 내역, FAIL SELECT #{item.failTxId}, r.trade_id, r.wallet_id, 'FAIL'::transaction_type_enum, 'CASH'::asset_type_enum, 'IN'::direction_enum, r.fail_amount, uw.cash_balance, 0, 0, NOW(), 0, #{item.failHashValue} FROM result r INNER JOIN update_wallet uw ON r.wallet_id = uw.wallet_id WHERE r.fail_amount > 0

mapper.select: -- 배당 스냅샷 (반환용) SELECT u.user_id, w.wallet_id, h.token_id, h.token_balance FROM holdings h JOIN wallets w ON h.wallet_id = w.wallet_id JOIN users u ON w.user_id = u.user_id WHERE h.token_balance > 0 AND h.token_id = #{tokenId}
mapper.insert:
-- 배당 스냅샷 (저장용) INSERT INTO dividend_hists ( token_id, wallet_id, cur_token_balance ) VALUES
( #{item.tokenId}, #{item.walletId}, #{item.tokenBalance} )

update.foreach: -- 1. 배당금 입급 WITH updated_wallet AS ( UPDATE wallets SET cash_balance = cash_balance + #{item.amount} - #{item.fee}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE wallet_id = #{item.walletId} RETURNING cash_balance ) -- 2. 배당 내역 삽입 INSERT INTO transaction_hists ( transaction_id, trade_id, wallet_id, transaction_type, direction, asset_type, amount, balance_after, hash_value, fee ) SELECT #{item.transactionId}, #{item.dividendId}, #{item.walletId}, 'DIVIDEND'::transaction_type_enum, 'IN'::direction_enum, 'CASH'::asset_type_enum, #{item.amount}, uw.cash_balance, #{item.hashValue}, #{item.fee} FROM updated_wallet uw; -- 3. 스냅샷 테이블 업데이트 UPDATE dividend_hists SET transaction_id = #{item.transactionId}, dividend_amount = #{item.amount} - #{item.fee}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE token_id = #{item.tokenId} AND wallet_id = #{item.walletId}

mapper.update: UPDATE tokens SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE token_id = #{tokenId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tokens ( token_name, ticker_symbol, total_supply, issue_price, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tokenName}, #{tickerSymbol}, #{totalSupply}, #{issuePrice}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: -- 토큰 존재 여부 확인 SELECT token_id, deleted_at FROM tokens WHERE token_id = #{tokenId}
